spec.hypothesis: The causal excursion effect of delivering an activity suggestion on log 30-minute step count is smaller on weekends than on weekdays (negative weekend x suggestion interaction).
spec.falsification: Not supported if, on the test partition, the Holm-adjusted p-value of the weekend interaction is >= 0.05 or the interaction has a positive sign.
spec.model: WCLS (Boruvka et al. 2018) with Y = g'alpha + (A - p)(beta0 + beta1 * weekend) + e and g = [1, log(pre + 0.5), study_day, weekend]; p = empirical P(send | available) in the test partition; participant-cluster sandwich SE with CR1 and t(G-1); participant cluster bootstrap (2000) reported alongside.
caveats: 15 test participants; power for an interaction of this size is low (in simulation, beta1 = 0.20 with 37 participants was rejected in 50-74% of replicates); a null here is weak evidence of absence.
The exploratory dev effect is in-sample; this run is the only inferential test.
